help.title: Hypixel Starfy — Commands
help.desc:
**/link** `<ign>` — link your Minecraft account (verified via Hypixel socials)
**/unlink** — remove your link
**/stars** `[user|ign]` — show a player's BedWars stars
**/update** — refresh your own stars now (max 10/hour)
**/help** — this message

**Admins:** /force-link, /force-unlink, /refresh
**Server managers:** /config (auto-detect & nickname sync, language) — /scan-members
